description: AlphaFold pLDDT profile of human R3HDML by region, and cysteine inventory
code:
exec(open("work/caplib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r3 = parse_pdb("work/af/R3HDML_human.pdb")
seq = seqof(r3)
plddt = np.array([x["b"] for x in r3])
print("R3HDML AF model: %d residues" % len(r3))
print(seq)

regions = {"signal 1-24":(1,24), "propeptide 25-56":(25,56), "mature 57-253":(57,253),
           "SCP/CAP 67-207":(67,207), "C-term 208-253":(208,253)}
rows=[]
for k,(a,b) in regions.items():
    v = plddt[a-1:b]
    rows.append(dict(region=k, n=len(v), mean_pLDDT=round(float(v.mean()),1),
                     min=round(float(v.min()),1), max=round(float(v.max()),1),
                     frac_gt70=round(float((v>70).mean()),2), frac_gt90=round(float((v>90).mean()),2)))
df_pl = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(df_pl.to_string(index=False))

# cysteines
cys = [i+1 for i,a in enumerate(seq) if a=="C"]
print("\nCysteine positions (1-based, full precursor):", cys)
print("Cys in CAP domain 67-207:", [c for c in cys if 67<=c<=207])
print("Cys in C-terminal 208-253:", [c for c in cys if c>207])
print("C-terminal tail sequence 208-253:", seq[207:253])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.2))
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(plddt)+1), plddt, lw=1.2, color="#2b6cb0")
for (a,b),c,lab in [((1,24),"#cbd5e0","signal"),((25,56),"#fbd38d","propeptide"),
                    ((67,207),"#9ae6b4","CAP/SCP domain"),((208,253),"#feb2b2","C-terminal tail")]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.45); ax.text((a+b)/2, 104, lab, ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(70, ls="--", lw=0.8, color="grey"); ax.axhline(90, ls=":", lw=0.8, color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Residue (Q9H3Y0 precursor numbering)"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_ylim(0,110); ax.set_xlim(1,len(plddt))
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence across human R3HDML (AF-Q9H3Y0-F1-v6)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
